title: 第1章 废物赘婿第2章 葬天古戒
content_zh:
大罗王朝，苏家。
“苏尘意欲谋害同族天骄，心思歹毒，罪孽深重，但念在其父于族有功地份上，长老会决定，废除修为，逐出苏家，立即送往北荒城，入赘叶家为婿，终生不得回归苏家！”
大殿之上，一个身穿黑袍的老者，面无表情的说道。
两侧，站着众多苏家长老，大都面容冷漠，有些人的神情更是充满了嘲讽。
而在下方跪着一个面容清秀的少年。
听到大长老宣读的命令之后，他浑身颤抖，猛然抬起头来，看着上手的一道身影，眼神中满是愤怒和痛苦的神色。
“苏晴雪，你欺人太甚！”
少年低吼，指甲深陷掌心，流出了滴滴鲜血。
大殿上方的座椅上，一个身穿雪白长裙，身材修长，面容绝美无比的少女坐在那里。
她的目光冷漠无比，淡淡的扫过苏尘，就像是在看一只蝼蚁，充满了高傲和轻蔑。
她是苏晴雪！
苏家的天骄，如今的少主。
“苏晴雪，你强行夺我血脉，却反过来污蔑我非礼你，狼心狗肺才是你的真面目吗？”
清秀少年，名为苏尘。
他看着苏晴雪，眼神中满是无比痛苦的神色。
苏尘出生之时，有飞龙降世，龙吟声响彻天地，被誉为苏家真龙！
苏尘十岁时，觉醒了天龙血脉，天生肉身强大，直入力武境，十二岁入气武境，十五岁入真武境，十六岁就已经是真武境九层的修为。
他天赋无双，耀眼夺目，被称为苏家崛起的希望！
然而天有不测风云，苏尘十五岁那年，他的父亲苏战，也是苏家的家主外出为苏尘寻找肉身洗礼的宝物，却葬身于秘境之中。
苏晴雪的父亲，苏有德成为了苏家家主。

苏晴雪和苏尘年龄相仿，武道天赋同样极其出色，更是觉醒了吞天蟒血脉，比起苏尘的天龙血脉只是稍弱一筹，同样是天级血脉。
苏晴雪自幼和苏尘青梅竹马，一直追在苏尘的身后喊他尘哥哥。
两人的关系也是极好。
苏尘对苏晴雪毫无保留，各种修炼心得，武技秘术全都传授给了苏晴雪，甚至于在十六岁那年，即将突破玄武境的时候，也是让苏晴雪为他护法。
但是，苏尘根本没有想到，就在他闭关修炼的时候，苏晴雪和苏有德一起，将他打晕，而后硬生生的抽出了苏尘的天龙血脉。
然后，苏尘亲眼看着苏晴雪的吞天蟒血脉，吞噬了他的天龙血脉。
苏晴雪一举突破了玄武境，成为了大罗王朝历史上，最年轻的玄武境天才！
甚至，苏晴雪更是被玄天宗收为弟子。
苏尘血脉被毁，则是彻底的沦为了废物。
“大胆苏尘，你竟敢污蔑少主，做下这种下贱勾当，竟还不思悔改！”
“哼，你父子二人本就不是我苏家之人，老家主仁慈，赐你们苏姓，还让你父亲当了家主，你应该知道感恩，怎敢恩将仇报？”
“苏尘，你不心怀感恩，竟然还对少主意图非礼，简直是狼子野心！
少主岂是你这种癞蛤蟆所能觊觎的？”
“……”
周围的众多苏家长老，你一言我一语，眼神中满是冷笑之色，对苏尘不断地呵斥。
而后，他们看向苏晴雪的目光中满是谄媚的笑容。
“苏尘！”
苏晴雪站了起来。
她身段婀娜，肌肤胜雪，面容完美无缺，居高临下的俯视着苏尘，眼神中满是冷漠之色。
“这个世界，强者为尊，弱者只能任由宰割！”

“你如今不过是一个废物罢了，我有心留你一命，你莫要不知好歹！”
苏晴雪神情冷淡，义正言辞地说道。
随后，却又精神传音道：“能将血脉献于我，是你的福气和造化！
content_en:
Daluo Dynasty, Su family.
"Su Chen wanted to murder the genius of his own clan. He had evil thoughts and serious crimes. However, because of his father's meritorious service to the clan, the Council of Elders decided to abolish his cultivation, expel the Su family, and immediately send him to Beihuang City to marry into the Ye family as his son-in-law. He will not be allowed to return to the Su family for the rest of his life!"
Above the main hall, an old man in black robe said expressionlessly.
On both sides, there were many elders from the Su family standing, most of them with indifferent faces, and some of them had expressions full of ridicule.
And kneeling below was a young man with a delicate face.
After hearing the order read out by the great elder, he trembled all over, suddenly raised his head, and looked at the figure in front of him, his eyes full of anger and pain.
"Su Qingxue, you are going too far!"
The young man growled, his nails dug into his palms, and drops of blood flowed out.
On the seat above the main hall, a girl wearing a snow-white dress, with a slender figure and an extremely beautiful face sat there.
Her eyes were extremely cold, and they swept over Su Chen lightly, as if looking at an ant, full of arrogance and contempt.
She is Su Qingxue!
The genius of the Su family and now the young master.
"Su Qingxue, you took my blood by force, but in turn accused me of molesting you. Is this your true face?"
A handsome young man named Su Chen.
He looked at Su Qingxue, his eyes full of pain.
When Su Chen was born, a flying dragon came to the world, and its roar resounded throughout the world. It was known as the Su family's true dragon!
When Su Chen was ten years old, he awakened the bloodline of the Heavenly Dragon. He was born with a strong physical body and entered the Liwu Realm. He entered the Qi Martial Realm at the age of twelve, entered the True Martial Realm at the age of fifteen, and was already at the ninth level of the True Martial Realm at the age of sixteen.
His talent is unparalleled and dazzling, and he is called the hope of the Su family's rise!
However, something unexpected happened. When Su Chen was fifteen years old, his father Su Zhan, the head of the Su family, went out to find the treasure for Su Chen's physical baptism, but he was buried in a secret realm.
Su Qingxue's father, Su Youde, became the head of the Su family.
Su Qingxue and Su Chen were similar in age, and both had extremely outstanding martial arts talents. They had also awakened the Sky-Swallowing Python bloodline, which was only slightly weaker than Su Chen's Heavenly Dragon bloodline, and was also a heaven-level bloodline.
Su Qingxue had been childhood sweethearts with Su Chen since childhood, always chasing after Su Chen and calling him Brother Chen.
The relationship between the two is also very good.
Su Chen had no reservations about Su Qingxue. He taught Su Qingxue all kinds of cultivation experience and martial arts secrets. Even at the age of sixteen, when he was about to break through to the Xuanwu realm, he asked Su Qingxue to protect him.
However, Su Chen never thought that while he was practicing in seclusion, Su Qingxue and Su Youde knocked him out together, and then forcibly extracted Su Chen's Tianlong bloodline.
Then, Su Chen watched with his own eyes as Su Qingxue's Sky-Swallowing Python bloodline devoured his Heavenly Dragon bloodline.
Su Qingxue broke through the Xuanwu Realm in one fell swoop and became the youngest Xuanwu Realm genius in the history of the Da Luo Dynasty!
Su Qingxue was even accepted as a disciple by Xuantian Sect.
Su Chen's bloodline was destroyed and he was completely reduced to waste.
"How dare you, Su Chen, how dare you slander the young master and do such a despicable thing, but you still don't want to repent!"
"Hmph, you and your son are not from my Su family. The old family master was kind and gave you the Su name and made your father the family head. You should be grateful. How dare you repay kindness with enmity?"
"Su Chen, you are not grateful, and you are still trying to be rude to the young master. It is simply a wolfish ambition!
Is the young master something a toad like you can covet? "
"..."
There were many elders from the Su family around, talking to each other, with sneers in their eyes, and they kept scolding Su Chen.
Then, they looked at Su Qingxue with flattering smiles in their eyes.
"Su Chen!"
Su Qingxue stood up.
She had a graceful figure, skin as good as snow, and a flawless face. She looked down at Su Chen with a look of indifference in her eyes.
"In this world, the strong are respected, and the weak can only be slaughtered!""You are nothing more than a loser now. I have the intention to save your life, so don't be ungrateful!"
Su Qingxue looked cold and spoke righteously.
Then, he mentally transmitted the message: "It is your blessing and good fortune to be able to dedicate your blood to me!
